summary: SEALSQ Corp filed a 6-K confirming the October 1, 2026 closing of the WISeSat.Space (d/b/a SpaceAIQ) business combination with Columbus Acquisition Corp., a Cayman SPAC equivalent, and concurrent PIPE. SEALSQ sold its SpaceAIQ shares for 1,040,478 WISeSat Ordinary Shares and 1,040,478 Class F Shares, and invested via PIPE at $10.79 per share, receiving 926,784 Ordinary Shares, rounded down. The PIPE carries a 60-day price-protection mechanism and customary lock-up. WISeSat Ordinary Shares began Nasdaq trading October 2, 2026, under SAIQ. Watch resale lock-up expiry and potential additional share issuance if the market price stays below $10.79.
